card.title: Helpful Culprit
card.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office plant's dead. I'll interview everyone who watered it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent lead. I'll test the machine. It may be dispensing something harmful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made that coffee yourself. With six sugars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll prepare six-sugar samples for comparison. We may be dealing with a plant that couldn't handle hospitality.

mechanism: A eagerly investigates a dead plant while moving culpability from their coffee watering to the machine and the plant.
confusable: Unlike defensiveness alone, A must keep offering useful-looking investigative work as personal evidence grows.
comparison: D13-b volunteers samples after the recipe is identified; D13-a volunteers preservation after a shard is found attached.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
